intro.h2: Custom cabinets in Atwater, built by a family team
paragraphs: Jaime's Custom Cabinets builds custom cabinets in Atwater from its shop at 3514 Atwater Blvd. It is a father-and-son business: reviewers talk about Jaime, his son and their team, and one customer spoke with both Jaime Sr. and Jaime Jr. about a cabinet door problem.

One family hired the team for cabinets in their kitchen, laundry room, bathroom and wet bar, plus countertop and backsplash, after comparing other cabinet professionals in the area. They wrote that the work was finished fast and perfectly, the pricing was very reasonable, and the team truly cares about a project no matter how small it is.

items.name: Custom kitchen cabinets
items.blurb: Kitchen cabinets built to fit your room, from shaker doors and a decorative arched hood over the range to tall cabinets for a wall oven. The photos on Google show both bright white and dark stained kitchens from the shop.

image.alt: White shaker cabinets with arched range hood valance, glossy white subway tile and marble-look countertop

items.name: Bathroom, laundry and wet bar cabinets
items.blurb: Cabinets are not only for kitchens. One family had Jaime and his team build cabinets for their laundry room, bathroom and wet bar along with the kitchen, and said they finished the projects fast and perfectly.

items.name: Countertops and backsplash
items.blurb: Finish the room in one go. Reviewers mention countertop and backsplash work alongside the cabinets, and the shop's photos show a white stone-look countertop with a glass and stone mosaic backsplash over dark stained cabinets with frosted glass doors.

image.alt: Dark stained shaker cabinets with frosted glass uppers, white granite-look countertop and mosaic tile backsplash

items.name: Cabinet door fixes and advice
items.blurb: Small problems count too. A customer having trouble with some cabinet doors spoke with Jaime Sr. and Jaime Jr., and both gave him the easiest way to solve it. Call if a door or hinge on your cabinets is giving you trouble.

about.text: Jaime's Custom Cabinets is a family cabinet shop at 3514 Atwater Blvd in Atwater, California. Jaime runs it with his son, and reviewers talk about Jaime, his son and his team as professional, attentive to detail, committed and reliable. One customer spoke with Jaime Sr. and Jaime Jr. on the same call. The shop builds custom cabinetry and also handles countertop and backsplash work, from full kitchens to a bathroom, laundry room or wet bar. Google review highlights call it an overall 10/10 experience with the best cabinet makers in Atwater.

And the most important aspects of all, they truly care about your project (no matter how small it is) and are very trustworthy.

Jaime and his team did cabinets in our kitchen, laundry, bathroom and wet bar along with countertop and backsplash. Pricing is very reasonable. They finished our projects fast and perfectly! Jaime did everything we asked him to. All he wanted is to make us happy and completely satisfied.

service_area.h2: A cabinet shop in Atwater, California
service_area.text: Jaime's Custom Cabinets is at 3514 Atwater Blvd C, Atwater, CA 95301, and Google review highlights call it the best cabinet makers in Atwater. Google shows no service area beyond the shop's own town. If you live outside Atwater, call (209) 819-6013 any day between 6 AM and 6 PM and ask whether your project is in range, or stop by the shop with photos and measurements of the room.

items.a: Custom cabinetry for kitchens, bathrooms, laundry rooms and wet bars, according to customer reviews, along with countertop and backsplash work. Photos on Google show white shaker kitchens and dark stained cabinets with frosted glass uppers. Call (209) 819-6013 to describe your room.
Google lists the shop as open every day of the week, Sunday through Saturday, from 6 AM to 6 PM. That makes it easy to call or stop by at 3514 Atwater Blvd C, before or after work, or on the weekend.

items.q: Can you help with a cabinet door that isn't working right?
items.a: Yes. One customer called about some cabinet doors he was having issues with, spoke with Jaime Sr. and Jaime Jr., and wrote that they both gave him the easiest way to solve the problem. Call (209) 819-6013 and describe what the door is doing.

items.q: Do you do countertops and backsplash too?
items.a: Yes. A customer who had cabinets built for the kitchen, laundry, bathroom and wet bar also had Jaime's team do the countertop and backsplash, and recommended them for all custom cabinetry, countertop and backsplash projects. Ask about materials when you call.

items.q: How much do custom cabinets cost?
items.a: It depends on the rooms, sizes, materials and finish you choose. Reviewers describe the pricing as very reasonable, and Google highlights repeat that. Call (209) 819-6013 or stop by the shop with measurements and photos and ask how the quote works for your project.

final_cta.h2: Ready for cabinets that fit your home?
final_cta.text: Call Jaime's Custom Cabinets any day from 6 AM to 6 PM.
